name: Wishly – Wishlist for WooCommerce
author: scodeware

sections.description:
Wishly is a lightweight wishlist plugin for stores that want core WooCommerce wishlist functionality without a bloated setup.

Customers can save products from archive pages and single product pages, review everything from a dedicated wishlist page, update quantities, remove items, and move saved products to cart quickly.

For store owners, Wishly includes flexible menu linking, shortcode support, button customization, product wishlist counters, and an admin dashboard for browsing customer wishlist records.

If you want a clean wishlist experience for your customers, this plugin is for you.

Features

  • Add to wishlist from shop loops and single product pages.
  • One wishlist per logged-in customer.
  • Wishlist page available through WooCommerce My Account.
  • Shortcode support with [scodeware_wishly_wishlist].
  • Add all saved products to cart from the wishlist page.
  • Update wishlist item quantities and remove products without leaving the page.
  • Choose notice or modal feedback after adding a product to the wishlist.
  • Optional tooltip for the wishlist button.
  • Customize wishlist heart colors, position, and offsets.
  • Optional wishlist counters on shop loops and single product pages.
  • Menu wishlist link with configurable position and optional custom destination page.
  • Admin dashboard to review wishlist records and inspect saved items.
  • Optional cleanup setting to remove plugin data on uninstall.

Premium Features

Wishly Premium extends the core single-list workflow with advanced wishlist, sharing, gifting, automation, and admin capabilities.

  • Multiple wishlists per customer.
  • Advanced wishlist controls and extended My Account workflows.
  • Public wishlist sharing and private/shared visibility controls.
  • Collaborators for shared list management.
  • Guest wishlist support.
  • Gift purchase flow and received gift management.
  • Estimate requests and quote-to-cart flow.
  • Back-in-stock alerts and sale notifications.
  • Trending analytics and promotional campaigns.
  • REST API endpoints for integrations.
  • Public wishlist SEO controls.
  • Privacy and compliance tools.

Usage

  1. Activate the plugin and make sure WooCommerce is active.
  2. Decide whether customers should access their wishlist through My Account or via a custom page using the shortcode.
  3. Configure button behavior, menu placement, and display settings under Wishlist > Settings.
  4. Customers can start saving products immediately after logging in.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Go to Wishlist > Settings and configure the wishlist page, menu link, and button appearance.
  5. Optionally add [scodeware_wishly_wishlist] to any page if you do not want to use the My Account endpoint.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Does this plugin work for guest users?

No. Wishly is designed for logged-in customers.

Can customers move wishlist items to cart quickly?

Yes. They can add all wishlist items to cart from the wishlist page.

Can users edit wishlist items?

Yes. Users can update quantities and remove items anytime.

Is there a shortcode for displaying the wishlist?

Yes. Use [scodeware_wishly_wishlist] to render the wishlist where needed.

Can I disable the My Account wishlist page?

Yes. You can disable the My Account endpoint and point the menu wishlist link to a page that contains the shortcode instead.

Can I customize the wishlist button appearance?

Yes. You can control heart colors, button position, offsets, tooltip behavior, and wishlist counters from the plugin settings.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

By default, wishlist data remains in place. You can enable the cleanup setting if you want Wishly to remove its data and settings on uninstall.
